answer: A farm would have to pack 1,400 real reams at 1,400 real benches, while one packer packs a single run. Check the pearl and the forgery falls apart. Sybils fail here because the plume always points back to real work. A ream packing slip is stamped at the packing bench with the ream count, the sheet size, and the wrapper check. The ledge stays with the work, not with the claim.
